title: A harder AI index tests agents on 657 guarded business workflows
friendlyTitle: New tests show AI agents still struggle to finish whole business jobs safely
summary: Artificial Analysis updated its Intelligence Index with Terminal-Bench v4 and AutomationBench-AA, a held-out set of 657 finance, HR, marketing, operations, sales and support tasks. Leading models complete many objectives, but the best reported full-workflow completion rate without a guardrail violation is only 41.6%.
friendlySummary: The updated index gives models 657 business tasks and checks both the work and the rules. The strongest model finished every part safely in fewer than half of the workflows.
whyItMatters: The gap between partial progress and a fully correct, policy-compliant workflow is the number buyers should notice. Teams comparing models should test complete outcomes, guardrail failures and cost on their own tasks—not choose from one headline score.
friendlyWhyItMatters: A model can look good while only finishing part of a job. Businesses should test full results, mistakes, rule-breaking and cost before choosing a model.
